lyrics:
[Intro: handclaps, walking bass, soft electric piano]

[Verse 1: falsetto group vocals, easy]
Quarter for the locker, key on a pin
Hot concrete and the smell of the wind
Radio on the lifeguard chair
Everybody I knew was there

[Chorus: full soul groove, strings]
That was the summer of the high dive
Ten feet tall and terrified
Whole pool looking, toes on the edge
Then the sky, then the water, then my head
Came up laughing, came up new
Summer of the high dive
I think about it when I'm scared, I do

[Verse 2: falsetto, guitar answering]
Snack bar window, frozen lime
My brother counting, one more time
Mama waving from the shallow end
I'd give a lot to jump for her again

[Chorus: full soul groove, strings]
That was the summer of the high dive
Ten feet tall and terrified
Whole pool looking, toes on the edge
Then the sky, then the water, then my head
Came up laughing, came up new
Summer of the high dive
I think about it when I'm scared, I do

[Bridge: claps and bass only, voices in rounds]
Climb, climb (don't look down)
Climb, climb (don't look down)

[Final Chorus: full groove, strings higher]
That was the summer of the high dive
Ten feet tall and terrified
Whole pool looking, toes on the edge
Then the sky, then the water, then my head
Came up laughing, came up new
Summer of the high dive
I think about it when I'm scared, I do

[Outro: handclaps, a diving board springing, a far splash]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 98 BPM, 4/4, F major. A soft, strolling 1970s soul groove, warm and nostalgic.

VOICE: Group falsetto: three or four men and women singing together in close harmony throughout, light and sweet, with no single lead. In the bridge they sing in overlapping rounds.

INSTRUMENTS: A walking electric bass, handclaps on two and four, a dry, soft drum kit, a Rhodes electric piano, a clean wah-wah rhythm guitar, a small string section, tambourine, a flute line in the last chorus.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, claps and bass. 0:12 Verse 1. 0:38 Chorus 1. 1:10 Verse 2. 1:36 Chorus 2. 2:08 Bridge, claps and bass. 2:24 Final chorus. 2:56 Outro, claps, a diving board and a splash, ends 3:08.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Modern recording of a 1974 soul band: warm, dry and slightly saturated, strings sweet, voices blended into one sound.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'Then the sky, then the water, then my head' at 0:50.

STATION FIT: 1:30 p.m., early afternoon. The most nostalgic song in the pack and the one closest to live soul, a rest from programmed beats.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Remembering, afraid, flying, grateful.
